'''Silver Town''' (Japanese: '''ジルバタウン''' ''Jitterbug Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]]. It is located between [[Saffron City]] and [[Lavender Town]]. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], it is home to a [[Contest Hall]], attracting several [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s who wish to enter the [[Kanto Grand Festival]].

[[File:Silver Contest poster.png|thumb|left|210px|A poster for the town's Pokémon Contest showing the Silver Ribbon]]
It is a town surrounded by mountains and forests. It can be assumed that the forests around Silver Town do not have many {{Berries}} because {{TRT}} spent an entire day searching for ingredients to make [[Pokéblock]]s but left town empty handed. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived there in ''[[AG151|Weekend Warrior]]'', in which {{an|May}} discovered that a [[Pokémon Contest]] was scheduled to take place soon and decided to enter in order to obtain the coveted Silver [[Ribbon]].

During the event, when [[Lilian Meridian|Lilian]] was introducing the contestants to the audience, a {{wp|salaryman}} called {{OBP|Jeremy|AG151}} burst through the doors and hurried to the stage. Although he was a little late, he was still allowed to compete. In the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], May commanded {{TP|May|Squirtle}} to use {{m|Bubble}}, which resulted in one large bubble in the middle of several smaller ones. Squirtle then used {{m|Ice Beam}} to pop the small bubbles and make an ice sculpture out of the big one.

Later, it was Jeremy's turn to appeal, and he entered the stage wearing a rocker outfit and playing the guitar. He sent out his {{p|Butterfree}}, who used a [[Contest combination|combination]] of {{m|Sleep Powder}} and {{m|Stun Spore}}. He then told it to use {{m|Safeguard}}, and at that moment his wife {{OBP|Mandy|AG151}} and his son {{OBP|Nicholas|AG151}} appeared, interrupting his performance to convince him to go home.

However, Jeremy did not want to give up, as he had been planning to enter a Pokémon Contest for a long time, spending hours {{pkmn|training}} his {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. After May encouraged him, he told his family how important Contests are to him, and decided to stay. Upon seeing that, the Chief of the {{pkmn|Activities Committee|Contest Committee}}, [[Raoul Contesta]], told him to finish his performance, and when the results were [[Contest announcer|announced]] by Lilian, Jeremy was among the Coordinators moving on to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]].

There, May and Jeremy faced off in the finals, with May using her {{TP|May|Combusken}} and Jeremy using his {{p|Venusaur}}. The two had a hard-fought battle, which ended after Combusken hit Venusaur with {{m|Sky Uppercut}}, rendering it unable to battle and prompting the [[Contest Judge]]s to rule {{DL|Fainting|Battle Off}} for Venusaur. As a result, May was declared the winner, earning her second Kanto Ribbon.
